//: Local development against DynamoDB Local, MinIO, and, by default, an in-process user
pool. Nothing here is a secret: the pool id and client id are public identifiers, the
MinIO credentials are AWS's own documentation placeholders (see docker-compose.yml),
and the payment secret is still an ARN resolved through the developer's own AWS
While the Cognito ids below read REPLACEME, a Debug build serves sign-up and sign-in
from Development/LocalIdentity.cs — accounts in memory, tokens signed by the process —
so auth works with no AWS account. Put a real development pool's ids here and the
Cognito adapter takes over with no other change. See docs/security.md.
Media:ServiceUrl does the same for media: with it set, S3MediaStorage issues presigned
grants against MinIO (docker-compose.yml) instead of the in-memory LocalMediaStorage
stand-in. Clear it to go back to that stand-in if MinIO isn't running.

Cors.//: The Vite dev server, by both names it answers to — a browser treats localhost and 127.0.0.1 as different origins even though they're the same machine. Bare origins only — a trailing path never matches.
